create.name: Sarah Robinson
create.bio:
Sarah Robinson is a yoga teacher, meditation guide and writer who lives on the edge of Wiltshire, a few miles from Bath. After many years of yoga practice and a background in psychology and neuroscience, she began writing books that bring together movement, stillness and the folklore of the witch. Her first, Yoga for Witches, has been translated into several languages and reissued in an expanded illustrated edition, and it was followed by Yin Magic, on slow yin practice and Taoist ideas of receptivity, and a run of books on kitchen lore, wild woodland and the witch in the British landscape.

She is best known on Insight Timer for what she calls story journeys: guided visualisations that lead the listener through forests, seasons and myth, often drawing on Celtic, Norse and Saxon tales and on goddess figures. A collection of these scripts is published as Enchanted Journeys. She teaches seasonal yoga and meditation online, runs a monthly meditation and journalling circle, leads writing masterclasses with her publisher Womancraft, and hosts the Witch Country podcast, which follows her travels to places of folklore around Britain.

books.title: Yoga for Witches (Illustrated Edition): Revised, Updated, Expanded
books.author: Sarah Robinson
books.description: Her first book, now in an expanded illustrated edition five years on. It shows how yoga postures, breath, mantra and meditation can be woven together with simple spells and seasonal ritual, for beginners as well as practised yogis.

books.title: Enchanted Journeys: Guided Meditations for Magical Transformation
books.author: Sarah Robinson
books.description: More than thirty of her guided meditation scripts gathered in one volume, moving through woodland, underworld, myth and the turning seasons. They can be read quietly, recorded in your own voice or used to guide others.

books.title: Yin Magic: How to be Still
books.author: Sarah Robinson
books.description: A book on slow, held yin yoga and the Taoist thinking behind it, including the meridians. Sarah treats stillness itself as a kind of magical practice and an answer to busy modern life.

books.title: Kitchen Witch: Food, Folklore & Fairy Tale
books.author: Sarah Robinson
books.description: A blend of folklore, fairy tale and history about food, herbs and the women who worked magic at the hearth. It draws on old herbals and stories to show how cooking and the figure of the witch have long been linked.

books.title: The Kitchen Witch Companion: Recipes, rituals and reflections
books.author: Sarah Robinson, Lucy H. Pearce
books.description: A follow-up to Kitchen Witch written with Lucy H. Pearce. After reflecting on the gap between the romance and the reality of kitchen magic, it offers recipes, crafts, meditations and blessings for each festival of the Wheel of the Year.

courses.title: Yoga For Witches: Sweet Spells Of Stillness
courses.description: A five-day Insight Timer course combining gentle movement, breath and meditative ritual. It is designed as a short, restful retreat that can be done at home.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: An Enchanted & Empowered Year
courses.description: An Insight Timer course of story journeys and practices that follow the seasons through the year. Sarah draws on myth and folklore to mark each turning point.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Finding the Witch in the Landscape Masterclass (Replay)
courses.description: The recording of a live masterclass Sarah taught for Womancraft Publishing, with its course materials. It uses images, stories and folklore to explore where the witch still lingers in the land, with writing and reflection prompts.

courses.title: The Wildwood by Firelight Masterclass: Story, Spell, and Spark (Replay)
courses.description: A recorded masterclass built around her book on the witch and Britain's ancient woods. It includes readings, guided writing and a simple seasonal ritual, along with the class materials.

free_resources.title: Sarah Robinson on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her free library of story journey meditations, seasonal yoga and journalling prompts, plus a monthly live meditation and writing circle. Free to listen to.
